dialogues.jp: 卒業式がつづがなく終わった。
dialogues.en: The graduation ceremony passed without incident.
dialogues.text: The graduation ceremony passed without incident.

dialogues.jp: 理事長の話、校長の話、市長の話、送辞に答辞。
dialogues.en:
One by one, the speeches came from the director, the
president, the mayor, and the farewell address.
dialogues.text:
One by one, the speeches came from the director, the
president, the mayor, and the farewell address.

dialogues.jp:
どれもこれも似たような話で、ありがたみなん
てありゃしない。
dialogues.en:
They talked so much about this and that, that I doubt it was
worth anything to hear them.
dialogues.text:
They talked so much about this and that, that I doubt it was
worth anything to hear them.

dialogues.jp:
でも、バックで厳かに流れるＢＧＭを聞いてい
ると、なんだか感慨深くなるから不思議だ。
dialogues.en:
Although with the haunting BGM playing, mixing with the
solemn atmosphere, gave me some weird feelings.
dialogues.text:
Although with the haunting BGM playing, mixing with the
solemn atmosphere, gave me some weird feelings.

dialogues.jp:
ＨＲでは、暦先生のありがたいお言葉（珍しく
まともなことを言ってると思った。そして、実
際ありがたいと思った）をもらった。
dialogues.en:
At HR, Koyomi-sensei thanked us. (It was rare to hear her
say something so serious. In my mind, I returned the thanks
as well.)
dialogues.text:
At HR, Koyomi-sensei thanked us. (It was rare to hear her
say something so serious. In my mind, I returned the thanks
as well.)

dialogues.jp:
式が終わり、泣くことなど絶対なさそうな眞子
などが涙を浮かべているところを見ると、本当
にこれで最後だと思わざるを得なかった。
dialogues.en:
After the ceremony ended, with the amount of tears that was
being shed, you would've thought that this was really the
end.
dialogues.text:
After the ceremony ended, with the amount of tears that was
being shed, you would've thought that this was really the
end.

dialogues.jp:
と言っても、本校にあがる連中は、ちょっと校
舎が変わるだけで、特に何かが変わる訳ではな
いのだけれど。
dialogues.en:
Relatively speaking though, we were just going to the main
school; our classmates might change, but things'd still be
the same.
dialogues.text:
Relatively speaking though, we were just going to the main
school; our classmates might change, but things'd still be
the same.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、それでも感慨深い気持ちになるのは、や
はり付属を『卒業』したということが、俺の中
でのワンステップだったということだろう。
dialogues.en:
I didn't have such deep emotions about it; the "graduation"
from the affiliated school was simply a step on the
staircase of life.
dialogues.text:
I didn't have such deep emotions about it; the "graduation"
from the affiliated school was simply a step on the
staircase of life.

dialogues.jp: 卒パには、正直言って、興味はなかった。
dialogues.en:
If I were to be perfectly honest, I had no interest
whatsoever in the graduation party.
dialogues.text:
If I were to be perfectly honest, I had no interest
whatsoever in the graduation party.

dialogues.jp:
騒ぎ立てていたのは、あくまで自分達が脇役に
過ぎなかったからだ。
dialogues.en:
Those kind of events have two types of characters: the
mains, and the supporting cast. I, and most, were clearly
the latter.
dialogues.text:
Those kind of events have two types of characters: the
mains, and the supporting cast. I, and most, were clearly
the latter.

dialogues.jp:
脇役が、本筋をかき回す。主役達が目を回し、
｛ほんろう／翻弄｝される、それが面白くてあの手この手で年
間行事を荒らしていた。
dialogues.en:
While the mains would dominate proceedings, gather all the
attention, and basically lay waste to the entire event.
dialogues.text:
While the mains would dominate proceedings, gather all the
attention, and basically lay waste to the entire event.

dialogues.jp:
が、自分達が主役となれば……、引っかき回す
なんて、かったるくてやってられない。
dialogues.en:
Having to play to those roles... that was more trouble than
I wanted to handle right now.
dialogues.text:
Having to play to those roles... that was more trouble than
I wanted to handle right now.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、早々に引き上げ、ひとけのいない場所へ
向かった。
dialogues.en:
Instead, I started to search for a deserted place to just
hang around.
dialogues.text:
Instead, I started to search for a deserted place to just
hang around.

dialogues.jp:
ひとけのない場所というと、ここを思い出すと
いうのもどうかと思う。
dialogues.en:
And the first thing I thought of for a "deserted place", was
here.
dialogues.text:
And the first thing I thought of for a "deserted place", was
here.

dialogues.jp:
｛にぎ／賑｝やかなハコのすぐ裏だ。確かに人は来ないけ
れど、あまり雰囲気のいい場所ではない。
dialogues.en:
Right behind the building bustling excitement. I guess it
doesn't really have the best atmosphere.
dialogues.text:
Right behind the building bustling excitement. I guess it
doesn't really have the best atmosphere.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、体育館の中には準備室やら、放送室やら、
なんやかやあるおかげで、ハコ自体はうるさく
とも、ここは静かだ。
dialogues.en:
But with the preparation and broadcasting room right inside
the gym, while it was noisy within, it was nice and quiet
outside.
dialogues.text:
But with the preparation and broadcasting room right inside
the gym, while it was noisy within, it was nice and quiet
outside.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「月城……今日もその草の世話か？」
dialogues.en: "Tskishiro... looking after that plant again, today?"
dialogues.text: "Tskishiro... looking after that plant again, today?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「せっかく卒業パーティーなのに。一緒に回る
　やつはいないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"It's the graduation party, you know. Don't you have anyone
to look around the place with?"
dialogues.text:
"It's the graduation party, you know. Don't you have anyone
to look around the place with?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……いません」
dialogues.en: "...I don't."
dialogues.text: "...I don't."

dialogues.jp: 月城は、ふるふると首を横に振る。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro shook her head, left and right.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro shook her head, left and right.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...What about senpai?"
dialogues.text: "...What about senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「俺？　俺は、卒パなんてかったるくてやって
　らんないからさ。ひとけのないところで、の
　んびりしようかなってな」
dialogues.en:
"Me? I think the graduation party is more trouble than it's
worth. I came here to just rest in some deserted place."
dialogues.text:
"Me? I think the graduation party is more trouble than it's
worth. I came here to just rest in some deserted place."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、もしかしたら、月城も来てるかなって
　思ったしな」
dialogues.en: "Well, I also came here since I thought you'd be here."
dialogues.text: "Well, I also came here since I thought you'd be here."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。今日は卒業式だし、少し話がしたいなっ
　て思って」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. Today was the graduation ceremony after all, I wanted
to talk with you for a bit."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. Today was the graduation ceremony after all, I wanted
to talk with you for a bit."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...With me..."
dialogues.text: "...With me..."

dialogues.jp: 月城が、おずおずと自分のことを指さす。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro was nervously playing with her lips.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro was nervously playing with her lips.

dialogues.jp:
ぶっちゃけ、『先輩、卒業おめでとう』なんて
言って欲しかったりするわけだが、そんなこと
俺の口からは、さすがに言えない。
dialogues.en:
She seemed to want to say "Senpai, congratulations on your
graduation", but she just couldn't get it out.
dialogues.text:
She seemed to want to say "Senpai, congratulations on your
graduation", but she just couldn't get it out.

dialogues.jp: そこへ……。
dialogues.en: And then...
dialogues.text: And then...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はいッ！　月城さん発見！　ほらッ、遊びに
　行きましょう！」
dialogues.en: "Alright! Tsukishiro-san, found it! Let's go play!!"
dialogues.text: "Alright! Tsukishiro-san, found it! Let's go play!!"

dialogues.jp:
突然、脇から現われて、月城の腕を掴む何者か
の影。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, a shadowy figure appeared and grabbed Tsukishiro's
arm from the side.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, a shadowy figure appeared and grabbed Tsukishiro's
arm from the side.

dialogues.jp: 「き、貴様ッ！　……み、美春」
dialogues.en: "Y, you!... Oh, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Y, you!... Oh, Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さんは、美春が預かりましたッ！　一緒
　に温泉卓球部のバナナミルクサンデーを食べ
　に行くんですもん！」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro-san's under my custody now! I'm going to take
her to the hot springs table tennis club and eat banana milk
sundaes!"
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro-san's under my custody now! I'm going to take
her to the hot springs table tennis club and eat banana milk
sundaes!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いいですよね、月城さん」
dialogues.en: "It'd be good, Tsukshiro-san!"
dialogues.text: "It'd be good, Tsukshiro-san!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「すっごくおいしいと評判なんです！」
dialogues.en: "it's famous for it's amazing taste!"
dialogues.text: "it's famous for it's amazing taste!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...O, okay."
dialogues.text: "...O, okay."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、珍しく美春のペースに巻き込まれなが
ら、うろたえたまま返事をする。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, for once, let herself be caught up in Miharu's
infectious energy, and flusteredly replied with her assent.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, for once, let herself be caught up in Miharu's
infectious energy, and flusteredly replied with her assent.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はい、じゃあ、行きましょう。なにか言い残
　したことは？」
dialogues.en: "Okay! Then, let's go! Any last words?"
dialogues.text: "Okay! Then, let's go! Any last words?"

dialogues.jp:
戦場へ赴くんじゃないんだから、言い残した事っ
てなんだよ……。
dialogues.en:
You're not going to a battleground, what do you mean by last
words...
dialogues.text:
You're not going to a battleground, what do you mean by last
words...

dialogues.jp:
月城は、手袋に手をかけようとするが、美春に
腕を掴まれ、外すことができない。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro seemed like she wanted to take off her gloves,
but with Miharu holding on to one of her hands, she
couldn't.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro seemed like she wanted to take off her gloves,
but with Miharu holding on to one of her hands, she
couldn't.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……その、卒業」
dialogues.en: "...Congratulations."
dialogues.text: "...Congratulations."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……おめでとうございます」
dialogues.en: "...On your graduation."
dialogues.text: "...On your graduation."

dialogues.jp: たどたどしい、言葉で月城がそう言った。
dialogues.en:
With considerable difficulty, Tsukishiro finally managed to
say it.
dialogues.text:
With considerable difficulty, Tsukishiro finally managed to
say it.

dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「では、バナナの聖地へレッツゴー！」
dialogues.en: "Now then, let's go the sacred land of bananas!"
dialogues.text: "Now then, let's go the sacred land of bananas!"

dialogues.jp:
そして、月城は美春によって、どこか遠くへ連
れ去られて行ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, swallowed up by Miharu, was then whisked away to
who-knows-where.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, swallowed up by Miharu, was then whisked away to
who-knows-where.

dialogues.jp: 「台風のようなヤツだな……」
dialogues.en: "She's like a typhoon..."
dialogues.text: "She's like a typhoon..."

dialogues.jp:
月城がいなくなって、体育館裏はまったくひと
けがなくなってしまった。
dialogues.en:
With Tsukishiro gone, this place can really be called
deserted.
dialogues.text:
With Tsukishiro gone, this place can really be called
deserted.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、例の月城の育てていた草がそよそよと風
に揺れていた。
dialogues.en: The only things left were Tsukishiro's plant, and the wind.
dialogues.text: The only things left were Tsukishiro's plant, and the wind.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、いつものブロックに腰掛け、その草が風
になびいている様を眺めることにした。
dialogues.en:
I took my usual seat on a block, and gazed at the scenery
before me.
dialogues.text:
I took my usual seat on a block, and gazed at the scenery
before me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、こんなところでなにしてんの？」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chan, what're you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chan, what're you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……さくらか。驚かすなよ」
dialogues.en: "...Sakura. You surprised me."
dialogues.text: "...Sakura. You surprised me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、驚かせてなんかいないよぅ」
dialogues.en: "I didn't meaaaaann to!"
dialogues.text: "I didn't meaaaaann to!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お前みたいなヤツが、突然出てくれば、たい
　ていのヤツは驚くんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Look at yourself. Anyone would be scared by you suddenly
appearing out of nowhere."
dialogues.text:
"Look at yourself. Anyone would be scared by you suddenly
appearing out of nowhere."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにょー、無茶苦茶だよぅ」
dialogues.en: "That's rubbish~"
dialogues.text: "That's rubbish~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……で、俺に何か用か？」
dialogues.en: "...Anyway, what do you want with me?"
dialogues.text: "...Anyway, what do you want with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ううん、ちょっとお話ししておきたいことが
　あって」
dialogues.en: "Well, I have something to say to you."
dialogues.text: "Well, I have something to say to you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「話しておきたいこと？」
dialogues.en: "Something to say?"
dialogues.text: "Something to say?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「本当は、黙っていようと思ったんだけれど、
　ボクにはどうしてもできなかったよ」
dialogues.en:
"To be honest, I wanted to keep quiet about it, but in the
end, I couldn't."
dialogues.text:
"To be honest, I wanted to keep quiet about it, but in the
end, I couldn't."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんのことだ？」
dialogues.en: "What's this about?"
dialogues.text: "What's this about?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あのね、ボクね、本校にはあがらないよ」
dialogues.en: "Well... I'm not going to the main school."
dialogues.text: "Well... I'm not going to the main school."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「？　……この前転校してきたばかりなのに、
　お前、何しに来たんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"? ......After you took all this trouble to come here? Then
why did you transfer in the first place?"
dialogues.text:
"? ......After you took all this trouble to come here? Then
why did you transfer in the first place?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それは、残念ながらヒミツ。ボクがお墓の中
　まで持って行かなくちゃ、いけないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Unfortunately for you, that's a secret. One I'd carry with
me to my grave."
dialogues.text:
"Unfortunately for you, that's a secret. One I'd carry with
me to my grave."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそりゃ」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「訳は聞かないで。──それでね。来週から、
　時々家を空けちゃうと思うけれど、気にしな
　いで」
dialogues.en:
"...I'm not gonna tell you. And after next week, there may
be times where I won't be home for long periods... don't
worry."
dialogues.text:
"...I'm not gonna tell you. And after next week, there may
be times where I won't be home for long periods... don't
worry."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「家を空けちゃうって……お前」
dialogues.en: "Won't be home... you mean you're..."
dialogues.text: "Won't be home... you mean you're..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ、色々とやらなければいけないことが
　たくさんあるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, there's a lot of complicated things happening right
now."
dialogues.text:
"Well, there's a lot of complicated things happening right
now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それは、お前だけしかできないことなのか？
　俺に何か手伝えることはないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Things that you can't do yourself? Is there anything I can
help with?"
dialogues.text:
"Things that you can't do yourself? Is there anything I can
help with?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「優しいんだね、お兄ちゃんは」
dialogues.en: "You're kind, onii-chan~"
dialogues.text: "You're kind, onii-chan~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「バーカ。悲劇のヒロインみたいな話し方をし
　てるのがウザイだけだ」
dialogues.en:
"...Stuuupid, I just don't like hearing tragic herione
acts."
dialogues.text:
"...Stuuupid, I just don't like hearing tragic herione
acts."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんね。でも、これはボクひとりでやらな
　ければならないことなんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry! But this is something I have to do myself, whether I
succeed or not."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry! But this is something I have to do myself, whether I
succeed or not."

dialogues.jp: さくらは、くすりと笑いながら、そう言った。
dialogues.en: Sakura spoke with little giggles tempering her speech.
dialogues.text: Sakura spoke with little giggles tempering her speech.

dialogues.jp:
まるで、俺の心を見透かしているような微笑み
だった。
dialogues.en:
A laugh that semed to indicate that she could see through my
heart.
dialogues.text:
A laugh that semed to indicate that she could see through my
heart.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、そんな感じに｛・・・・・／それっぽく｝言えてる時点
　で、さほど心配はいらないってことだな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, if you feel that way, and since you told me
beforehand... I guess I won't be as worried as I could've
been."
dialogues.text:
"Well, if you feel that way, and since you told me
beforehand... I guess I won't be as worried as I could've
been."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん、ただ黙っていなくなっちゃうのはどう
　かと思って、報告しに来ただけ。ホント、心
　配はいらないよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, that's why I decided against not telling you, and
came here. Really, don't worry about me."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, that's why I decided against not telling you, and
came here. Really, don't worry about me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「わかった。特に心配しないことにしておく」
dialogues.en: "Alright, I'd try not to."
dialogues.text: "Alright, I'd try not to."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん、ありがとう。──あれ、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Okay, thanks. ...Oh, onii-chan!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, thanks. ...Oh, onii-chan!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「この花、もしかしてロスキルラベンダー？」
dialogues.en: "Is this flower, by any chance, a Roskill Lavender?"
dialogues.text: "Is this flower, by any chance, a Roskill Lavender?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なに？　ラスカルのベランダ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? A rascal's veranda?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? A rascal's veranda?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「無理して、言い間違えないでいいよ……。ロ
　スキルラベンダー。この花のこと」
dialogues.en:
"Don't try to say it if you don't know... I said, Roskill
Lavender."
dialogues.text:
"Don't try to say it if you don't know... I said, Roskill
Lavender."

dialogues.jp:
さくらはそう言って、月城が育てている草を指
差した。
dialogues.en:
She pointed to the plant Tsukishiro was growing, as she
spoke.
dialogues.text:
She pointed to the plant Tsukishiro was growing, as she
spoke.

dialogues.jp: 「それ、ロスキルラベンダーっていうのか？」
dialogues.en: "That's called a Roskill Lavender?"
dialogues.text: "That's called a Roskill Lavender?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ。ヨーロッパの寒い地方の花」
dialogues.en:
"Yep! It's a flower that only grows in cold climates in
Europe."
dialogues.text:
"Yep! It's a flower that only grows in cold climates in
Europe."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えらく詳しいな」
dialogues.en: "You know a lot about it."
dialogues.text: "You know a lot about it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あにゅ、これでも植物学の博士号を持ってる
　んだよ？」
dialogues.en:
"It's the least you can expect from someone with a
bachelor's degree in botany."
dialogues.text:
"It's the least you can expect from someone with a
bachelor's degree in botany."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そういや、そんなこと言ってたような気がす
　るな」
dialogues.en: "You should be careful about just saying that so casually."
dialogues.text: "You should be careful about just saying that so casually."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でも、おかしいなぁ。日本の気候じゃ、とて
　も育ったりしないんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"This is strange, though. A flower like Roskill Lavender
shouldn't be able to grow in Japan's climate..."
dialogues.text:
"This is strange, though. A flower like Roskill Lavender
shouldn't be able to grow in Japan's climate..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「植えてるヤツが、熱心に育ててるからじゃな
　いのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Even if the person growing it is putting all her heart and
soul in it?"
dialogues.text:
"Even if the person growing it is putting all her heart and
soul in it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「植えた人を知ってるの？」
dialogues.en: "You know the person growing it?"
dialogues.text: "You know the person growing it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。２年の月城ってヤツだ。さっきまでい
　たんだけど、美春のヤツに連れ去られてしまっ
　た」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, it's a 2nd year student, named Tsukishiro. She was
here earlier, but got dragged away by Miharu."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, it's a 2nd year student, named Tsukishiro. She was
here earlier, but got dragged away by Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「んで、その月城は、ほとんど毎日付きっきり
　でその草の世話をしてたんだ。だからじゃな
　いのか？」
dialogues.en:
"And she's been watching over it practically every day. With
dedication like that, it shouldn't be impossible, right?"
dialogues.text:
"And she's been watching over it practically every day. With
dedication like that, it shouldn't be impossible, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ううん。植物ってのはね、すごくデリケート
　なんだよ。一晩温度が上がり下がりしただけ
　で簡単に枯れちゃったりするものなんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Not quite... Roskill Lavenders are extremely delicate. A
sudden change in Ntemperature will cause it to wither."
dialogues.text:
"Not quite... Roskill Lavenders are extremely delicate. A
sudden change in Ntemperature will cause it to wither."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「特にこのロスキルラベンダーっていうのは、
　高地の温度が低い場所でしか育たない植物の
　はずなんだけど……」
dialogues.en:
"Because of that, you won't ever see Roskill Lavenders
growing in mountaineous regions, or in valleys."
dialogues.text:
"Because of that, you won't ever see Roskill Lavenders
growing in mountaineous regions, or in valleys."

dialogues.jp: さくらが、眉をひそめながら、うーんと｛うな／唸｝る。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's attention was entirely focused on the plant. Her
eyebrows were raised, as she emitted a low "hmm" noise."
dialogues.text:
Sakura's attention was entirely focused on the plant. Her
eyebrows were raised, as she emitted a low "hmm" noise."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「一生懸命育ててるからって、こんなに簡単に
　育つものじゃないはずなんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"No matter how much effort a person puts into raising it, it
won't just grow that easily."
dialogues.text:
"No matter how much effort a person puts into raising it, it
won't just grow that easily."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「絶対育たないのか？」
dialogues.en: "So it definitely won't grow?"
dialogues.text: "So it definitely won't grow?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「確かに、絶対……って訳じゃないけど、そう
　簡単には育たないはずだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well... not definitely. But it'd still take more than just
effort."
dialogues.text:
"Well... not definitely. But it'd still take more than just
effort."

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、地面にへばりつくようにして、その
｛・・・・・・・・・／ロスキルラベンダー｝を観察する。
dialogues.en: She continued her observation of the plant as she talked.
dialogues.text: She continued her observation of the plant as she talked.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「一応、温度差による病害が出てるから、突然
　変異とかって訳じゃないみたい」
dialogues.en:
"For example, it requires the temperature to remain
constant, like it has been for the past few weeks."
dialogues.text:
"For example, it requires the temperature to remain
constant, like it has been for the past few weeks."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら……お前、すごいな」
dialogues.en: "Sakura... you're amazing."
dialogues.text: "Sakura... you're amazing."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だから、ボクは、博士号を持ってるくらい詳
　しいんだってば。植物学での特許もいくつか
　持ってるんだよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Like I said, I DO specialize in botany. This bachelor's
degree isn't just for show."
dialogues.text:
"Like I said, I DO specialize in botany. This bachelor's
degree isn't just for show."

dialogues.jp:
さくらがほっぺたを膨らませて、俺をじろりと
｛にら／睨｝む。
dialogues.en:
Sakura suddenly looked up from her squatting position, and
stared at me.
dialogues.text:
Sakura suddenly looked up from her squatting position, and
stared at me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でも、花はまず咲かないと思う。育ててる人
　には申し訳ないけど、しばらくしたらつぼみ
　もつけずに枯れちゃうと思う」
dialogues.en:
"But, I don't think this will bloom. It may be harsh on the
person growing it, but I think it'd start withering very
soon."
dialogues.text:
"But, I don't think this will bloom. It may be harsh on the
person growing it, but I think it'd start withering very
soon."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「な、なんてこと言うんだよ」
dialogues.en: "W, why do you say that?"
dialogues.text: "W, why do you say that?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だって、本当のことだもの。葉っぱとか茎と
　か見てたら、だいたいわかるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Because it's true. You can see it easily by the state of
the stalk and the leaves."
dialogues.text:
"Because it's true. You can see it easily by the state of
the stalk and the leaves."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でも、これは植物博士としては、非常に興味
　をそそられる存在だね」
dialogues.en:
"Although, just the fact that this plant exists in such a
climate is worthy of further investigation by experts."
dialogues.text:
"Although, just the fact that this plant exists in such a
climate is worthy of further investigation by experts."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「たとえ、枯れるとしてもここまで育ってるっ
　ていうことは、なかなかあることじゃないも
　の」
dialogues.en:
"There won't be much difference in how well you grow it now;
it seems destined to wither away."
dialogues.text:
"There won't be much difference in how well you grow it now;
it seems destined to wither away."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ぜひ、研究対象に……」
dialogues.en:
"While certainly, it'd have it's uses in biological
experiments..."
dialogues.text:
"While certainly, it'd have it's uses in biological
experiments..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ダメッ！　一生懸命育ててるヤツがいるんだ
　からそんなことしちゃダメッ」
dialogues.en:
"No! You can't! Not while there's still someone giving it
her all trying to make that grow..."
dialogues.text:
"No! You can't! Not while there's still someone giving it
her all trying to make that grow..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Booo..."
dialogues.text: "Booo..."

dialogues.jp:
さくらがむくれた子どものような顔をしたまま
立ち上がる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura hopped up from her squatting position, sulking like a
child.
dialogues.text:
Sakura hopped up from her squatting position, sulking like a
child.

dialogues.jp:
そして、膝の土を払いながら『ちょっとくらい
ヘーキなのに……』とぶつぶつ文句を言ってい
た。
dialogues.en:
She then started scraping off the dirt from her skirt,
muttering TO herself whether it looks okay.
dialogues.text:
She then started scraping off the dirt from her skirt,
muttering TO herself whether it looks okay.

dialogues.jp: ──ドゴーーーン！
dialogues.en: --*baaaaaaang!*
dialogues.text: --*baaaaaaang!*

dialogues.jp: 「なっ、なんだ！？」
dialogues.en: "W, what the!?"
dialogues.text: "W, what the!?"

dialogues.jp:
校舎の方から、白い煙がもくもくと立ち上って
いた。
dialogues.en: White smoke was pouring out of the school building.
dialogues.text: White smoke was pouring out of the school building.

dialogues.jp: 「杉並かっ！！」
dialogues.en: "SUGINAMI!!"
dialogues.text: "SUGINAMI!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「化学部かも」
dialogues.en: "The chemistry club, more likely."
dialogues.text: "The chemistry club, more likely."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どっちでもいい、ちょっと行ってくる」
dialogues.en: "Whatever it is, we better go take a look."
dialogues.text: "Whatever it is, we better go take a look."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やじうまだねぇ」
dialogues.en: "And be busybodies, huh?"
dialogues.text: "And be busybodies, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「言ってろ」
dialogues.en: "you should talk."
dialogues.text: "you should talk."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、さくらを放っぽって、煙の立つ校舎の方
に向かった。
dialogues.en: I left Sakura, heading for the source of the white smoke.
dialogues.text: I left Sakura, heading for the source of the white smoke.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「まさか、ロスキルラベンダーがこんなところ
　で成長するなんて……不思議だな」
dialogues.en:
"Seeing a Roskill Lavender growing here... how very
strange."
dialogues.text:
"Seeing a Roskill Lavender growing here... how very
strange."

dialogues.jp: ◆ロスキルラベンダー◆
dialogues.en: ◆Roskill Lavender◆
dialogues.text: ◆Roskill Lavender◆

dialogues.jp:
今日で卒業だ。卒業証書もありがたい言葉もど
うでもよかったが、やはり感慨深い。
dialogues.en:
Today was graduation day. All the hullabaloo of receiving
our raduation certificates and so on, moved something inside
me.
dialogues.text:
Today was graduation day. All the hullabaloo of receiving
our raduation certificates and so on, moved something inside
me.

dialogues.jp:
そんな感慨深い気持ちで、月城に会いに行った
のだが、パーティーに出席する美春の手によっ
て連れ去られてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Feeling slightly emotional, I went to see Tsukishiro, but
she was eventually whisked away by Miharu.
dialogues.text:
Feeling slightly emotional, I went to see Tsukishiro, but
she was eventually whisked away by Miharu.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、その間際に『先輩、卒業おめでとう』な
んて言われて、ちょっと嬉しかったが。
dialogues.en:
At least she managed to tell me "Senpai, congratulations on
your graduation", which made me happy.
dialogues.text:
At least she managed to tell me "Senpai, congratulations on
your graduation", which made me happy.

dialogues.jp:
その後、さくらがやってくる。あいつは本校に
はあがらないから、という報告をしに来たのだ。
dialogues.en:
After that, Sakura appeared. She came to tell me that she
wouldn't be ascending to the main school like the rest of
us.
dialogues.text:
After that, Sakura appeared. She came to tell me that she
wouldn't be ascending to the main school like the rest of
us.

dialogues.jp:
音夢といい、さくらといい、どうしてみんな俺
の側から離れていくんだ……。
dialogues.en:
First Nemu, now Sakura, why does everyone seem to be leaving
my side...
dialogues.text:
First Nemu, now Sakura, why does everyone seem to be leaving
my side...

dialogues.jp:
さくらが、傍らに生えている月城の草を見て、
不思議そうな顔をした。
dialogues.en:
Sakura, upon seeing Tskushiro's plant nearby, was surprised
by it.
dialogues.text:
Sakura, upon seeing Tskushiro's plant nearby, was surprised
by it.

dialogues.jp:
その草は、ロスキルラベンダーという、寒い地
方の花で、日本の気候では、うまく育たないは
ずだというのだった。
dialogues.en:
That plant was a Roskill Lavender, a plant that grows only
in cold cliamtes. It isn't supposed to be able to grow in
places like Japan.
dialogues.text:
That plant was a Roskill Lavender, a plant that grows only
in cold cliamtes. It isn't supposed to be able to grow in
places like Japan.

dialogues.jp:
成長するのは、運がよければ、可能かも知れな
いが、この気候では、花はまず咲かないだろう
ということだった。
dialogues.en:
Apparently, the fact that the flower grew this much has been
down to luck, and the chance of it growing any further was
nil.
dialogues.text:
Apparently, the fact that the flower grew this much has been
down to luck, and the chance of it growing any further was
nil.

dialogues.jp: 月城の行動は……無駄なのだろうか……。
dialogues.en: So Tsukishiro's actions... are all going to be for naught...
dialogues.text: So Tsukishiro's actions... are all going to be for naught...
